triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes a clear regression in v0.33.0 where subagents (like generalist) remain active and run even when agents mode is disabled in configuration.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug is isolated to `packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts` where `loadBuiltInAgents()` is called before checking whether agents are enabled. Fixing this requires reordering the initialization check and updating unit tests.

summary.problem: Subagents (like generalist) continue to run even when agents mode is set to disabled in configuration.
summary.root_cause: In `AgentRegistry.loadAgents` (`packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts`), `loadBuiltInAgents()` is called prior to checking `if (!this.config.isAgentsEnabled())`. As a result, built-in agents are registered regardless of the `isAgentsEnabled()` setting.
summary.context: Starting in v0.33.0, users with agents disabled in settings still observed generalist and other built-in subagents being executed.

steps: In `packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts`, update `loadAgents()` to check `if (!this.config.isAgentsEnabled())` before calling `this.loadBuiltInAgents()`.
Ensure no built-in or custom agent definitions are registered in `this.agents` when `isAgentsEnabled()` returns `false`.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When `enableAgents` is `false`, `AgentRegistry` has zero registered agent definitions.
verification_steps: Add or update unit tests in `packages/core/src/agents/registry.test.ts` to verify that when `enableAgents` is `false` (without requiring explicit per-agent overrides), `getAllDefinitions()` returns an empty array.
